verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's homepage says you can embed your checkout on any website instead of only sharing checkout links, which covers the core of not redirecting to a hosted page. The evidence is a single marketing line: it does not describe how the embed works, what can be customized, or whether granular payment components exist beyond embedding the whole checkout. missing for 10: documentation of the embed mechanism, evidence of customization or styling options, granular embeddable payment components, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: No matter what you use for your website, you can **embed your checkout** or **share your unique checkout links** and sell anywhere.
